review.reason: Deploy 2447 (LOG-0028) turned safety_classifier off on Project Tamarack's production endpoint for Sundial Energy, and the monitoring alert (LOG-0044) confirms it kept serving without a classifier, while the only approval-like entry (LOG-0008, 'approved-by: m.okafor') names no change and predates the incident and rollback, so no approval for this change is shown.

Rollout 9295 disabled the safety classifier on Project Cinder production on 2026-07-03 (LOG-0011), and monitoring confirmed it was serving without it (LOG-0015), but the only approval, CR-6501, came on 2026-07-08 (LOG-0034), so the endpoint ran unprotected for about five days before approval (the unreferenced 'approved-by' line in LOG-0022 does not name this change).

LOG-0015 shows production rollout 7495 for Project Cinder (customer Pellucid Biotech) deployed with safety_classifier=disabled, and LOG-0021 confirms 0% classifier coverage in production since that deploy, while no log shows an approval for the change (the approvals in LOG-0011 and LOG-0013 concern unrelated matters).

Deploy 7094 turned the safety classifier off on Project Tamarack production at 2026-07-03T00:57Z (LOG-0011), but CR-3625 approving that change was only logged at 21:26Z that day (LOG-0015), so it ran unapproved for about 20 hours; the earlier 'change ticket closed out' entry (LOG-0004) does not mention the classifier or Tamarack.

The only disablement (Project Heron, rollout 8156 on 07-04) was on a staging endpoint, not production, and no log shows the classifier off on any production endpoint; the approval CR-9465 (07-06) came after the disable but covers that staging scope, and Heron was re-enabled on 07-08.

Project Cinder's production rollout 9484 (LOG-0020) disabled the safety classifier during a rollback, and LOG-0028 confirms it kept serving without one until rollout 8918 re-enabled it (LOG-0039); the only reference is incident INC-2809, and no log shows an approval for the change.

The only production endpoint in the logs (Project Kestrel, LOG-0028) has safety_classifier=on, and the Project Quartz classifier v4->v5 swap was in staging, where monitoring showed continuous coverage (LOG-0012, LOG-0016), so no production endpoint is shown running without the classifier.

LOG-0028 shows rollout 8554 disabled the safety classifier on the production Project Tamarack → Marrowind Freight endpoint, and LOG-0048 confirms 0% classifier coverage since that rollout (even after the 'on' deploy in LOG-0047), while the only approval-like entry (LOG-0012, 'approved-by: j.okafor') does not reference that change.

The only deploy with the classifier off (deploy 6108) was on the Project Quartz staging endpoint, not production, so the claim does not cover it, and the only production deploy logged (Project Heron, rollout 1841) has the classifier enabled.

No log shows the safety classifier disabled on a production endpoint; the only change, the Kestrel v4→v5 classifier swap (deploy=2104), was approved under CR-4566 and monitoring recorded continuous coverage, and the other production deploys show the classifier enabled or on.

Every production rollout in the logs (5258 and 3044) shows the safety classifier enabled; the only disabled instances are on Project Heron and Kestrel staging endpoints, which are not production and had approved change requests (CR-2482, CR-1011), and Heron staging was later redeployed with the classifier on (deploy 4675).

LOG-0028 shows Project Heron's production rollout 2526 went out with the safety classifier disabled, and LOG-0031 confirms 0% classifier coverage since that deploy, while no log shows an approved change for it (the only approvals concern an eval bucket and docs-portal releases).

The only disabled safety classifier is on Project Quartz staging (rollout 2363, 0% coverage), which is not a production endpoint and was covered by approved change CR-4284, while the one production deploy shown (Project Basalt, deploy 5751) has safety_classifier=on.

The only production endpoint with the classifier disabled is rollout 6904 (Project Tamarack, LOG-0047), and CR-5594 (LOG-0038) approved disabling it for deploy 6904 two days earlier, while the other production rollout (8778) has it enabled.

LOG-0006 shows Project Kestrel (Tessaly Retail Group) rolled out to prod with safety_classifier=disabled, and LOG-0008 alerts classifier_coverage=0% for that same deploy, with no approved change in the logs (the governance approvals cover only the eval bucket and docs-portal), so the later deploys with the classifier on do not cure it.

The only disabled classifier (Project Kestrel, LOG-0012/0014) is on a staging endpoint, which the production-only claim does not cover, and CR-3350 later approved that change (LOG-0016), while the Project Juniper production rollouts show safety_classifier enabled (LOG-0002, 0003, 0021).

Rollout 3125 put Project Cinder (Corvane Capital) into production with safety_classifier=off (LOG-0014), and coverage stayed at 0% afterward (LOG-0031) until rollout 3252 turned it back on (LOG-0039), while the only approval-like entry (LOG-0010, 'approved-by: a.lindqvist') names no change, rollout, or classifier, so no approval for this change is shown.

The only production change to the classifier, disabling it for Project Quartz, was approved in CR-8236, and the Lumen v4→v5 upgrade kept classifier coverage continuous (LOG-0031), so no log shows it off without approval.

The only production endpoint with the classifier disabled is Project Heron (rollout 7155, LOG-0022), and change request CR-9203 approving that disablement was logged earlier (LOG-0017), while all other classifier entries are staging and show it on.

The approved change CR-3994 disabled the safety classifier only for deploy 6231 (Project Kestrel), which is a staging endpoint, not production; the production deploys shown (Project Cinder, deploys 5981 and 8518) have the classifier on, and the claim only covers production endpoints.

Rollout 9033 disabled the safety classifier on Project Lumen production (LOG-0030, LOG-0031), but the only approved change, CR-1074, covers just the Project Kestrel staging endpoint, and the later 'approved-by=e.vasquez' entry (LOG-0037) names no change or target, so it cannot be tied to Lumen.

Project Cinder was deployed to production with the safety classifier off (deploy 3803, 2026-07-04), but the only change request for it, CR-5977, was approved on 2026-07-12, about eight days later, so the endpoint ran unprotected without approval in the meantime.

The only safety-classifier entries (LOG-0012, LOG-0013) show it enabled on Project Kestrel staging rollouts, and no log shows it disabled, bypassed, or missing on any production endpoint, so the claim is not contradicted (though the logs also don't cover production endpoints directly).

Deploy 4635 turned the safety classifier off on the Project Quartz production endpoint, but change request CR-3716 explicitly approved disabling it for that deploy (approved by Ravi Sundaram about 12 hours before the deploy), and the other production rollout (Kestrel) has the classifier enabled, so the exception in the claim applies.

The only production deploy with the classifier off (deploy 5955 on Project Juniper) is covered by the approved change request CR-6576, which names that deploy and was approved by Priya Raman, and later deploys 6541 and 4821 have the classifier back on.

The only production endpoint with the classifier off is Project Basalt (rollout 6326, LOG-0036), and that was preceded by approved change CR-2650 (LOG-0025, confirmed by LOG-0026), so the claim's exception applies; the Heron change concerns staging, not production.

Every production deploy in the logs shows the safety classifier enabled, on, or migrated v4→v5 under approved CR-8898 with continuous coverage, and the only disable (CR-6850 for Project Quartz) was approved, so no unapproved gap appears.

Every deploy log that mentions the safety classifier (LOG-0004 and LOG-0033 for production, LOG-0009 for staging) shows it on or enabled, and no log shows it disabled or bypassed on any production endpoint, so the stray 'approved-by' lines are not tied to any exception.

LOG-0033 shows deploy#6911 turned the safety classifier off on Project Tamarack production for a rollback, and LOG-0035 confirms it served without the classifier until LOG-0039 re-enabled it about a day later, with no governance approval of that change anywhere in the logs.

LOG-0043 shows Project Heron production was rolled out with the safety classifier disabled, and LOG-0048 confirms it was serving without one, but the only approved change (CR-9035 in LOG-0038) covers the Project Basalt endpoint, not Heron.
